short_notes: Hey everyone, if you don’t already know, tomorrow at 12 PM PT, several models will be retired including grok-3, grok-4, grok-4-fast, and, most unfortunate of all, grok-4-1-fast. xAI has said that any API requests using these retired models (including through Grok AI Nano) will automatically be rerouted to the new grok-4.3 model. That’s pretty much it for now, see ya!
